name: Carloforte (Italy)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Carloforte (a red cross on white, a lion, a tower and the sea) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Carloforte, a comune in Sardinia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Carloforte arms — red cross on white, a lion, a tower and the sea, crowned, within branches
